نحتبس (form VIII)
# نَحْتَبِسُ (naḥtabisu) /naħ.ta.bi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# نُحْتَبَسُ (nuḥtabasu) /nuħ.ta.ba.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# نَحْتَبِسَ (naḥtabisa) /naħ.ta.bi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# نُحْتَبَسَ (nuḥtabasa) /nuħ.ta.ba.sa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
